items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Oh, well, I happened to play a job with Big Eye Louie at

ctx.x: And let's see. Yeah, and Big Eye Louie played with Marnie too.

Oh, well, I happened to play a job with Big Eye Louie at, what's the name of that place you call it with Jews and them brothers with Pricewater. I played that election. I played that election one night. And Octave sent me down in his place. They all get a fresh piece. Thank you. Octave sent me down in his place one night and I played a chance. He was a fine clarinet player.
